messages:
Maya (AE): Quick help — HelixThera wants to run a 2-week Private POC. They asked for exact steps to create the Interface VPCE, DNS expectations, and what we need to accept it. Also asked if they can have a short-lived API key scoped to models and quota.
Arjun (Solutions): Short steps to share: 1) Create an Interface VPC Endpoint for the service_name we will send. Use subnets in 2 AZs. 2) Attach an SG allowing inbound TLS (443) from the app subnets. 3) Enable private_dns so the standard service hostname resolves to private IPs. 4) If nodes need images or updates, ensure NAT or relevant S3/ECR endpoints. 5) Provide vpce-id + aws account id to us.
Tala (Infra): Notes: We don't require customer to provide static egress IPs. PrivateLink traffic stays inside AWS networking. If their corporate firewall only allows known IPs outbound, they can proxy egress through a NAT with a stable IP before hitting the VPCE. We'll need the vpce-id to accept on our side and verify the service name.
Nina (Security): Security checklist: prefer security-group allowlists, avoid using NACLs for the VPCE ENIs. Confirm TLS is end-to-end; we terminate TLS with our certs. For scoped POC API keys — yes, we can issue a limited-time key (max 30 days) with model and rate limits; request via support ticket with customer org and intended usage.
Maya (AE): They asked about DNS: "If private_dns is enabled, is extra hosted zone work required?"
Arjun (Solutions): Usually no. When private_dns is enabled AWS will resolve the service hostname to the VPCE private IPs in their VPC. Only add records in a private hosted zone if they want a custom internal name; then point that name to the VPCE DNS name (CNAME/ALIAS).
Tala (Infra): Quick connectivity test to ask them to run after creating VPCE: `curl -v https://api.redwood-inference.internal/health` from an instance in the app subnet. Also `dig +short api.redwood-inference.internal` to confirm private IPs. Post outputs here and we'll accept.
ticket-bot: Created support ticket RW-POC-811: "HelixThera VPCE acceptance + POC key" 1: assigned to Tala and Nina.
Maya (AE): I'll send the checklist + tiny Terraform snippet and ask for subnet ids, account id, vpce-id and whether they need a limited key. Can Tala own acceptance?
Tala (Infra): I'll take acceptance. Ping me when vpce- is posted.
Maya (AE): Thanks all — sending now. :thumbsup:
